# Vertexa Digitals

> Premium digital agency for ambitious global brands — web development, mobile apps, SEO, performance marketing, branding, and content marketing.

Vertexa Digitals is a founder-led, full-service digital agency serving ambitious brands across the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, and Australia. Every project is touched by our founders — no outsourced labor, no middlemen. Also known as Vertexa or Vertexa Digitals Agency.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/web-development): Custom websites and web apps using Next.js, React, Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, and headless CMS. Fast, SEO-optimized, conversion-focused.
- [Mobile App Development](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/mobile-app-development): Native iOS, Android, and cross-platform apps built with React Native and Flutter.
- [SEO Services](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, on-page optimization, link building, international SEO, e-commerce SEO, SaaS SEO, local SEO, and off-page SEO.
- [Performance Marketing](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/performance-marketing): Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, and conversion rate optimization.
- [Branding & Design](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/branding-design): Brand identity, logo design, UI/UX design, design systems, and website redesign.
- [Content & Social Media](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/content-social-media): Content strategy, blog writing, social media management, copywriting, and email marketing.

## Sub-Services

- [Shopify Development](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/web-development/shopify): Shopify store design, development, and optimization.
- [WordPress Development](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/web-development/wordpress): Custom WordPress websites and plugins.
- [Next.js Development](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/web-development/nextjs): High-performance Next.js web applications.
- [Google Ads Management](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/performance-marketing/google-ads): Google Search, Display, and Shopping campaigns.
- [Technical SEO](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/seo/technical-seo): Site audits, Core Web Vitals, structured data, and crawlability.
- [Brand Identity Design](https://vertexadigitals.com/services/branding-design/brand-identity): Logo, visual identity, and brand guidelines.

## About Vertexa Digitals

- [About Us](https://vertexadigitals.com/about): Founder-led team with expertise in web development, SEO, and digital marketing for global brands. No outsourced labor. Senior-led execution.
- [Industries We Serve](https://vertexadigitals.com/industries): SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, fintech, B2B, real estate, legal, and education.
- [Locations](https://vertexadigitals.com/locations): Serving clients in New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, London, Manchester, Edinburgh, Berlin, Amsterdam, Dublin, Sydney, and Melbourne.
